posts.text: We picked up over 1,000 pounds of trash in a mile! It’s mindblowing how much trash can stack up along a trail over time. My friend @Nelson Holland has been cleaning it up on his own mile by mile, but it’s become clear to him that that’s a feat that can only be accomplished by more than one person. Some stretches have a -lot- of trash, so we started bringing people together by throwing Colorado Creator Collective cleanups this year to build community and do some good. posts.text: Vibes of the Canadian PNW 🌧️ Some of the biggest trees on Earth hide here on Vancouver Island, so over 4,000 people have gone to send letters to protect its old growth rainforests from being cut down. The individual trees can be over 1,000 years old, but antique yellow cedar forests in their entirety are a special class of forest dating back to the last Ice Age that can be over 11,000 years old.
